Venus Sato: Morning all! I'm Venus — starting today as Data Platform SWE (remote, PST). Quick asks: who to ping for VPN/ssh and MDM? also assigned a buddy? tiny fun fact: used to run a ramen review blog 🍜
Ariana (People Ops): Welcome Venus!! 🎉 Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/venus (private) — for VPN/ssh start with IT below, buddy will be Sam K. I'll DM you calendar invites.
Sam K.: hey Venus — excited to pair. I'm your buddy, Sam (platform). Let's sync tomorrow 10am PT. For SSH keys, add public key to `~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub` then paste into the internal portal.
Venus Sato: awesome thanks Sam! i'll add my key now. also macbook M1 — any quirks?
Kai (Infra): Welcome! For VPN we use WireGuard. Install: `brew install wireguard-tools` then drop the config in `~/Library/Application Support/WireGuard/` and use the app. If you prefer GUI, `brew install --cask wireguard` works too.
Marta (MDM): @Venus Sato you should get an MDM invite email from Jamf within ~5min. If it's not there check spam; ping #it-help with device serial if issues.
IT Bot: Device enrollment ticket created — ticket #ENR-8247. Reply with device serial once you have it.
Venus Sato: got the Jamf invite and enrolled. serial SATO-VENUS-001. thanks!
IT Bot: Enrollment confirmed. Please reboot to finish installing dev certs.
Leo (Eng): :wave: welcome! if you want keyboard recs we have a small slack thread in #random — plenty of mech-heads. Also lunch poll: ramen vs tacos? :ramen: :taco:
Nora (Hiring Manager): Welcome to the team, Venus. We'll do a short 1:1 later today — I'll send a calendar invite. Excited to have your ramen expertise on board :smile:
Venus Sato: thanks everyone — rebooting now. Looking forward to pairing and meeting folks. Ping me if you want ramen recommendations :ramen:
Sam K.: OK great — 10am PT tomorrow stands. I'll drop a Zoom link.
Ariana (People Ops): Quick FYI: swag request form here: https://redwood.internal/swag — fill size & shipping. Also we'll ship a welcome snack box if you want.
Venus Sato: added swag form. tea over coffee, snack preferences: salted pistachios. :nut_and_bolt:
Marta (MDM): All set from MDM side. If any extension fails, run `sudo jamf recon` and paste output.
Venus Sato: `sudo jamf recon` output pasted to #it-help per instructions. thanks y'all!
Leo (Eng): see you in #standup tomorrow. :rocket:
